sources.title: Memory Hotplug
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: CXL 記憶體分層：依存取比例計算延遲預算
related.titleEn: CXL memory tiers: access-weighted latency budgeting
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付頁到區塊對照、重複釘住測例、可移除清單與不足原因，並註明目的地空間假設；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver page-to-block ownership, duplicate-pin tests, the eligible-block list and insufficiency reasons. State the destination-space assumption and distinguish predicted eligibility from a verified hot-remove operation. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 輸入 access_id、tier 與依賴鏈，另列 capacity_by_tier；禁止用容量表直接填入存取權重。
related.differenceEn: Build an access_id, tier and dependency-chain trace, with a separate capacity-by-tier table. Require access weights to come from the trace rather than copying capacity percentages into the latency formula.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課保守模型將含釘住頁的區塊全部視為不可移除，其餘區塊視為可成功遷移；容量為可移除區塊數乘區塊大小；十個各 256 MiB 區塊；名義三個被釘住，變更五個被釘住，區塊大小與總容量固定；名義式 (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB；變更式 (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。

兩層平均服務延遲為 local_fraction*local_latency 加 remote_fraction*remote_latency；只適用此無重疊、無排隊模型；本地 80 ns、擴充層 200 ns；擴充存取占比由 25% 改為 50%，存取總數固定；名義式 0.75*80+0.25*200 = 110 ns/access；變更式 0.5*80+0.5*200 = 140 ns/access。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The conservative fixture marks every block containing a pinned page as nonremovable and assumes all remaining blocks can migrate successfully. Removable capacity is eligible block count times block size. Model ten blocks of 256 MiB. Three blocks initially contain pinned pages, then five do. Block size and total installed memory remain fixed; migration destination capacity is assumed sufficient. Nominal (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB; changed (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Weighted mean service latency sums access fraction times latency for each tier. The model assumes serial dependence, no overlap and no queueing; it is not a bandwidth or application-runtime model. Assign synthetic latencies of 80 ns locally and 200 ns in the extension tier. Extension accesses increase from 25% to 50% while total access count remains fixed; these are not CXL product specifications. Nominal 0.75*80+0.25*200 = 110 ns/access; changed 0.5*80+0.5*200 = 140 ns/access. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: PFC watchdog：循環等待與阻塞佇列暴露
related.titleEn: PFC watchdog: cyclic waits and blocked-queue exposure
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付頁到區塊對照、重複釘住測例、可移除清單與不足原因，並註明目的地空間假設；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver page-to-block ownership, duplicate-pin tests, the eligible-block list and insufficiency reasons. State the destination-space assumption and distinguish predicted eligibility from a verified hot-remove operation. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 建立依賴邊與每佇列 byte_count；使用圖搜尋輸出循環成員，另外保留非循環但可能受阻的上游佇列。
related.differenceEn: Build dependency edges and queue byte counts. Use graph traversal to identify cycle members, keeping upstream queues that may be indirectly stalled in a separate category rather than labeling them all part of the cycle.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課保守模型將含釘住頁的區塊全部視為不可移除，其餘區塊視為可成功遷移；容量為可移除區塊數乘區塊大小；十個各 256 MiB 區塊；名義三個被釘住，變更五個被釘住，區塊大小與總容量固定；名義式 (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB；變更式 (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
教學圖中只有位於有向循環的佇列算循環阻塞；暴露位元組為這些佇列的已排隊量總和；三個佇列 A→B→C→A，各排隊 64 KiB；變更移除 C→A，並假設末端能排空；名義式 3*64 = 192 KiB in cycles；變更式 0*64 = 0 KiB in cycles。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The conservative fixture marks every block containing a pinned page as nonremovable and assumes all remaining blocks can migrate successfully. Removable capacity is eligible block count times block size. Model ten blocks of 256 MiB. Three blocks initially contain pinned pages, then five do. Block size and total installed memory remain fixed; migration destination capacity is assumed sufficient. Nominal (10-3)*256 = 1792 MiB; changed (10-5)*256 = 1280 MiB. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

In the teaching graph, only queues belonging to a directed cycle count as cyclically blocked. Exposed bytes are the queued bytes in those cycle members, not all traffic anywhere in the fabric. Start with A waiting for B, B for C and C for A, each holding 64 KiB. Remove C’s dependency on A and assume the terminal service can drain; all other queue sizes remain the initial snapshot. Nominal 3*64 = 192 KiB in cycles; changed 0*64 = 0 KiB in cycles. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
